dedupe_keys.name: perdite idriche degli acquedotti m1 dataset

description: Perdite idriche degli acquedotti M1 - Dataset is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.isprambiente.it. Water losses of national aqueducts, identified as parameter M1 and provided in terms of: linear water losses (mq/km/day) and percentage water losses (%). The data is provided annually by the operators of the integrated water service and then validated by ARERA who transmits it to ISPRA for appropriate technical and environmental assessments. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Water leakage of aqueducts M1 — Dataset" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include servizio idrico, open data, SII, perdite idriche. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
